stdout: --custom:custom cluster; nodes join separately via a registration command
--machine-config:machine config `kind/name` for the machine pool of a node-driver cluster; kinds: amazonec2config, azureconfig, digitaloceanconfig, harvesterconfig, vmwarevsphereconfig
--cloud-credential:cloud credential `id|display name` for a node-driver cluster
--k8s-version:Kubernetes `version`; required for --custom and for a node-driver cluster, optional for --import
--quantity:number of nodes in the machine pool (default: 1)
--debug:print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
--no-input:never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
--read-only:refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
